primitives.name: QB Expected Points Added from Defensive Penalties
primitives.verbatim_quote: Definition # (verbatim): "expected points each QB gained from defensive penalties # that otherwise wouldn't have produced any yards".
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'EPA_{\\text{pen}}': 'expected points added per quarterback from defensive penalties'}
primitives.assumptions: Defensive penalties alter play outcome without affecting standard yardage; EPA reflects value of penalty-induced change.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Quarterback-specific performance under penalty influence during 2026 Weeks 1–2.

layer2.mapping: EPA_{\text{pen}} quantifies how much defensive infractions improve QB outcomes beyond normal play.
layer2.telemetry: Per-QB EPA gain from penalties in full-table CSVs.

primitives.name: Team Expected Points Lost Due to Drops
primitives.verbatim_quote: Definition (verbatim): # "expected points each team has lost through two weeks due to drops".
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'EPA_{\\text{drop}}': 'expected points lost per team due to incompletions'}
primitives.assumptions: Drops represent missed opportunities that reduce expected scoring potential.

layer2.mapping: EPA_{\text{drop}} measures inefficiency in receiving corps relative to expected outcomes.
layer2.telemetry: Per-team EPA loss from drops in full-table CSVs.

primitives.name: Throw Type Distribution Across Plays
primitives.verbatim_quote: Time to Throw | # First Read | Second Read | Designated Receiver* | Checkdown | Scramble # (percentage of all throws).

reasoning_traces.think:
The primitives define core metrics for evaluating quarterback performance and team efficiency through expected points. EPA from defensive penalties isolates the impact of defensive missteps on QB outcomes, while EPA lost to drops captures inefficiencies in receiving. Throw type distributions provide insight into offensive structure and adaptability. These metrics form a unified framework where EPA serves as a common currency for evaluating both individual and collective performance. The failure mode lies in assuming static environments; dynamic adjustments in play-calling or personnel changes may invalidate these fixed-value estimates. Dualities emerge between defensive liability and offensive opportunity, with EPA acting as a bridge between them. Each metric must be interpreted within its specific regime—quarterback-specific for EPA_{pen}, team-wide for EPA_{drop}, and situational for throw types.
